claim_boundary: Independent synthetic validation of a surface association only. It is not real-speaker validation, a full S/F/H factorial study, causal identification of history in a population, human-validated Persona Fidelity, or algorithm validation.
measurement_limits: All personas are explicitly synthetic; no real-speaker generalization is supported.
The 24 cases are purposive controlled dialogue-choice cases, not a population sample.
S and F are held present, so this study estimates history semantics/surface associations rather than a full S/F/H factorial effect.
Exact opaque-anchor endpoints measure constrained choice behavior, not broad semantic quality or Persona Fidelity.
The DESIGNED_IRRELEVANT_CONTROL designation is a prospective material-design claim supported by recorded rationales, not an empirical guarantee that a model will perceive the history as irrelevant.
Human semantic and Persona Fidelity judgments remain pending and must not be fabricated.
The single-model study cannot establish cross-model generality.
Synthetic personas cannot establish real-speaker Persona Fidelity.
All history conditions are executed in one future batch, but NO_H versus H still bundles context length and additional entities.
Exact label/name choice is a constrained behavioral endpoint and does not by itself establish semantic quality.
RAW versus DECLARATIVE bundles speech act and tokenization differences; the registered surface estimand is not a pure causal decomposition.
The question was motivated by earlier outputs, although every case, target, persona, and exact template here is new.
No validated original algorithm is tested. Raw and declarative history are simple prompting baselines.
